Up in the Catskills of New York in the quiet little town, (yes ... there are quiet little towns in New York), of Stanfordville is a family 'Dude' resort called 'Roseland Ranch'. It's a 'full-blown' wannabe cowboy's dream! There's horseback riding, comfortable rooms, a shooting range, archery, swimming, sauna, pony rides and petting zoo for the kids, a huge arcade and food .... food you say? The best home cookin' East of your Mother! And Dominick makes sure the food just keeps on comin' (urrp! Oh, excuse me...I'm still stuffed!).
      The ranch mainly caters to an onslaught of 'weekend city slickers' but we had the entire ranch to ourselves for nearly a week!! Owner, Chickie, and her entire staff made these 'out-of-towners' real comfy and at home and we had the vacation of our lives! Many thanks Roseland Gang!
